inlines.text: OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6.1 Terra，进一步推进了成本效率前沿。这是自 GPT-5.6 以来的首个 Terra 级模型，智能更高，成本却不到三分之一

blocks.text: 每 token 价格是 GPT-5.6 Terra 的一半或更低——输入/输出每百万 token 分别为 $1/$5，而前代模型为 $2/$12。缓存写入也减半，现为每百万 token $1.25。缓存输入为四分之一，每百万 token $0.05，而此前为 $0.20。

blocks.text: 关键要点：

inlines.text: 关键要点：

blocks.text: ➤ 在低和中等 effort 下，智能与成本达到帕累托最优：在最大 effort 下，GPT-6.1 Terra 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上比 GPT-5.6 Terra 提升 6 分，而每任务成本不到三分之一（$0.40 对 $1.40）。在较低 effort 水平下，提升更大，介于 7 到 13 分之间。低和中等 effort 水平在成本效率上处于帕累托最优，而其他 effort 水平则位于前沿之后。在最大 effort 下，该模型在 Intelligence Index 中比 GPT-6.1 Sol 低 4 分，比 GPT-6 Luna 高 10 分。

blocks.text: ➤ 推进 Coding Agent Index 成本效率前沿：在新发布的 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v2.0 中得分为 48，比 GPT-6.1 Sol（54）低 6 分，比 GPT-6 Luna（31）高 17 分。xhigh 和 low effort 设置在 Coding Agent Index 中处于成本效率前沿，而其他 effort 水平则位于前沿之后。

blocks.text: ➤ 幻觉率下降 50 个百分点：在我们的私有知识与幻觉基准 AA-Omniscience 中，当 GPT-6.1 Terra 不知道问题答案时，有 38% 的情况会猜测。此前，GPT-5.6 Terra 的幻觉率为 88%。幻觉的大幅降低伴随着 AA-Omniscience 准确率提升 2 分——这意味着该模型同时正确回答了更多问题。

inlines.text: Key takeaways:

blocks.text: ➤ Pareto-optimal for Intelligence vs Cost at low and medium effort: At max effort, GPT-6.1 Terra gains 6 points in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index over GPT-5.6 Terra, at less than a third of the cost per task ($0.40 vs $1.40). At lower effort levels the gain is larger, between 7 and 13 points. The low and medium effort levels are Pareto-optimal for cost efficiency, while the other effort levels sit behind the frontier. At max effort, the model scores 4 points below GPT-6.1 Sol and 10 points above GPT-6 Luna in the Intelligence Index.

At lower effort levels the gain is larger, between 7 and 13 points. The low and medium effort levels are Pareto-optimal for cost efficiency, while the other effort levels sit behind the frontier. At max effort, the model scores 4 points below GPT-6.1 Sol and 10 points above GPT-6 Luna in the Intelligence Index.

blocks.text: ➤ Pushes the Coding Agent Index cost efficiency frontier: With a score of 48 in the newly released Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v2.0, the model is 6 points below GPT-6.1 Sol (54) and 17 points above GPT-6 Luna (31). The xhigh and low effort settings sit on the frontier of cost efficiency in the Coding Agent Index, while other effort levels are behind the frontier.

inlines.text: ➤ Pushes the Coding Agent Index cost efficiency frontier:

blocks.text: ➤ 50 point drop in hallucination rate: GPT-6.1 Terra guesses 38% of the time when it does not know the answer to a question in AA-Omniscience, our private knowledge and hallucination benchmark. Previously, GPT-5.6 Terra's hallucination rate was 88%. This significant reduction in hallucination is coupled with a 2 point increase in AA-Omniscience accuracy - meaning the model simultaneously answers more questions correctly.
